title: 第十七章 冲动是魔鬼第十八章 努力在天赋面前一文不值
lines: 丹阳峰，紧闭的房门内。
林昊盘坐蒲团之上，体表外有赤红色的火苗在飘荡。
体内，九条至尊神脉如九条苍龙，连通到丹田内，一个真气漩涡开始形成。
那是气海，已经被林昊开辟了出来。
在林昊开辟气海的那一刻，整个丹阳峰上的天地元气，都疯狂地向着房间内狂涌，如潮水般灌输到林昊体内。
“怎么如此大的动静，这是要开辟多大的气海？”
外面，一直守着的任百川都吃惊了。
林昊开辟出来的气海确实威猛，如一片汪洋，真气入海，滔滔不绝。
外面的天地元气甚至不够用，他还直接炼化了两颗下品元石，才将气海稳住。
短暂时间，林昊成功晋升气海境一重巅峰，即便是距离气海境二重，也是一步之遥。
正常情况下刚开辟气海不可能达到气海境一重巅峰，但林昊多了其他的加持。
火！
没错，至尊火。
至尊体本身就是一个宝库，是取之不尽用之不竭的资源，随着修为的不断提升，可不断开发出新的特殊能力。
这次九脉全开，体内直接觉醒了一种先天火焰，自至尊神脉内而出，赤红如霞，高高在上。
“好一个至尊火，不但让我多了一种手段，还能随时淬炼肉身，提升肉身实力。”
林昊眸子生辉，对至尊火的出现，相当满意。
他屈指一弹，至尊火化为一缕火苗，如灵蛇一般在手指尖跳跃，林昊意念一动，火苗颤抖，自动化为一把火焰剑，如臂使唤。
外面，任百川脸色狂变：“这是……先天火的气息。”
身为一个炼丹师，任百川对火焰的敏感度，远超常人。
砰！
林昊还在好奇的玩耍手中火焰，一会化龙，一会化剑，一会化刀，房门突然被人一脚干碎了，任百川风风火火站在门口，第一瞬就盯住林昊手中的火焰，瞳孔放大，眼冒金星，像是一个饥渴了许久的汉子，突然看到了绝世美女一丝不挂站在面前。
“任老，发情了吗？可别对着我啊。”
林昊连忙收起至尊火，后退两步。
“刚才那是，什么火焰？”
任百川非常激动，以他的眼力，林昊适才释放出来的火焰，绝对是先天火，等级极高，身为一个炼丹师，活了半辈子，亦是第一次见到这个等级的火焰。
“天生的。”
林昊老实说道。
“与生俱来？”
“差不多吧。”
虽然说至尊火才刚刚觉醒，但和与生俱来也没啥区别。
闻言，任百川生出一股挫败感，眼中充满羡慕嫉妒恨，最后爆了一句粗口：“草！”
太不公平了。
这世界哪有什么公平，有的人生来就是上天的宠儿，任百川努力一辈子求而不得的东西，林昊却是与生俱来。
content_en:
Danyang Peak, inside the closed door.
Lin Hao sat cross-legged on the futon, with red flames floating outside his body.
In the body, the nine supreme divine veins are like nine blue dragons, connected to the Dantian, and a vortex of true energy begins to form.
That was the Qi Sea, which had been opened up by Lin Hao.
The moment Lin Hao opened up the Qi Sea, the energy of heaven and earth on the entire Danyang Peak surged crazily into the room, pouring into Lin Hao's body like a tide.
"Why is there such a big movement? How big a sea of ​​air is this going to open?"
Outside, Ren Baichuan, who had been watching, was surprised.
The sea of ​​qi opened up by Lin Hao is indeed powerful, like a vast ocean, and the true qi flows into the sea and flows endlessly.
The energy of heaven and earth outside was not even enough, so he directly refined two low-grade Yuan stones to stabilize the sea of ​​energy.
In a short period of time, Lin Hao was successfully promoted to the peak of the first level of the Qi Sea Realm, and even he was one step away from the second level of the Qi Sea Realm.
Under normal circumstances, it is impossible for someone who has just opened up the Qi Sea to reach the peak of the first level of the Qi Sea Realm, but Lin Hao has other blessings.
fire!
That's right, Supreme Fire.
The Supreme Body itself is a treasure house, an inexhaustible resource. With the continuous improvement of cultivation, new special abilities can be continuously developed.
This time all nine meridians were opened, and a kind of innate flame was directly awakened in the body, coming out from the supreme divine vein, as red as the clouds, high above the sky.
"What a supreme fire. Not only does it give me one more method, it can also temper my body at any time and improve my physical strength."
Lin Hao's eyes shone, and he was quite satisfied with the appearance of the Supreme Fire.
With a flick of his finger, the Supreme Fire turned into a wisp of flame, jumping like a spiritual snake on his fingertips. Lin Hao moved his mind, the flame trembled, and automatically turned into a flaming sword, like an arm.
Outside, Ren Baichuan's face changed wildly: "This is... the breath of innate fire."
As an alchemist, Ren Baichuan's sensitivity to flames is far beyond that of ordinary people.
Bang!
Lin Hao was still curiously playing with the flame in his hand, turning into a dragon, a sword, and a knife. Suddenly, the door was shattered by someone's kick. Ren Baichuan stood at the door and stared at the flame in Lin Hao's hand for the first moment. His pupils were dilated and stars were shining in his eyes, like a man who had been hungry for a long time and suddenly saw a peerless beauty standing naked in front of him.
"Mr. Ren, are you in heat? Don't face me."
Lin Hao quickly put away the Supreme Fire and took two steps back.
"What kind of flame was that just now?"
Ren Baichuan was very excited. With his eyesight, the flames Lin Hao released just now were definitely innate fires, of extremely high levels. As an alchemist, this was the first time he had seen flames of this level in his half-life.
"Born."
Lin Hao said honestly.
"Innate?"
"Almost."
Although the Supreme Fire has just awakened, it is no different from being born with it.
Hearing this, Ren Baichuan felt a sense of frustration, his eyes filled with envy, jealousy, and hatred, and finally he cursed: "Fuck!"
So unfair.
There is no fairness in this world. Some people are born as God's darlings. What Ren Baichuan could not get after working hard all his life, Lin Hao was born with.
title_en: Chapter 17 Impulse is the devil Chapter 18 Effort is worthless in front of talent
